title: Philippines shows strong appetite for guaranteed 5G performance: Ericsson ConsumerLab
summary: 60% of Filipino 5G smartphone users see value in guaranteed network performance during critical moments. Over one-third of Filipino 5G smartphone users are willing to pay for enhanced connectivity experiences. Growing AI adoption is expected to increase demand for responsive and reliable connectivity experiences.
body_markdown:
- 60% of Filipino 5G smartphone users see value in guaranteed network performance during critical moments.
- Over one-third of Filipino 5G smartphone users are willing to pay for enhanced connectivity experiences.
